title: Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Fuel, Cleaning and Post-Rental Fee Schedule
content:
Fuel on every Bluegate Moving Truck Rental vehicle is read on a gauge marked in eighths of a tank, at pickup and again at return. The refuel charge, the cleaning fee and the smoking fee are class figures; the administrative fee for each toll or citation processed after the rental is the same on every class.

## Fuel

| Vehicle class | Fuel the vehicle takes | Gauge resolution | Refuel charge per eighth of a tank below the pickup level (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Pickup Truck | Gasoline | 8 eighths | 9.00 |
| Bluegate Cargo Van | Gasoline | 8 eighths | 10.00 |
| Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck | Gasoline | 8 eighths | 12.00 |
| Bluegate 15 ft Moving Truck | Gasoline | 8 eighths | 15.00 |
| Bluegate 20 ft Moving Truck | Gasoline | 8 eighths | 18.00 |
| Bluegate 26 ft Moving Truck | Diesel | 8 eighths | 24.00 |

## Return-condition and post-rental fees

| Vehicle class | Cleaning fee, cargo area returned with debris or needing sweeping (USD) | Smoking fee, evidence of smoking found at return (USD) | Administrative fee per toll or citation processed after the rental (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Pickup Truck | 25.00 | 150.00 | 25.00 |
| Bluegate Cargo Van | 25.00 | 150.00 | 25.00 |
| Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck | 35.00 | 150.00 | 25.00 |
| Bluegate 15 ft Moving Truck | 50.00 | 150.00 | 25.00 |
| Bluegate 20 ft Moving Truck | 50.00 | 150.00 | 25.00 |
| Bluegate 26 ft Moving Truck | 75.00 | 150.00 | 25.00 |

## Notes on the schedule

- Only the Bluegate 26 ft Moving Truck takes diesel; every other class takes gasoline.
- A full tank reads 8 eighths on every class, so a gauge reading is always a whole number from 0 to 8.
- The refuel charge is a price per eighth: the figure in the table is the amount for one eighth of a tank.
- The smoking fee (150.00) and the toll or citation administrative fee (25.00) do not vary by class.
